sentences.text: 2.  It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is the father-in-law of the deceased, who is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
sentences._hearing_file: Chhotelal vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned counsel further submits that by the efflux of time, trial began and during the trial, the statement of P.W.1 and P.W. 2 were recorded and they were declared hostile by the learned trial Court, copy of the statements of P.W.1 and P.W.2 are annexed as Annexure-SA1 and SA2 to the supplementary affidavit.
sentences._hearing_file: Chhotelal vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: He thus submits that no offence against the applicant is made out.
sentences._hearing_file: Chhotelal vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023.json

The circumstances which, according to the counsel, led to the Chhotelal vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134451489/

sentences.text: It has also been assured on behalf of the applicant that he is ready to cooperate with the process of law and shall faithfully make himself available before the court whenever required and is also ready to accept all the conditions which the Court may deem fit to impose upon him.

sentences.text: Hence the bail application is allowed.

1.

sentences.text:
Heard Sri Brij Lal Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Manoj Kumar Singh, learned
Brief Holder for the State.
2.
sentences._hearing_file: Chhotelal vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023.json

sentences.text:
The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 41 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 304B, 316 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Manikpur, District Chitrakoot during pendency of the trial.
3. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and his family members and according to the FIR marriage of the applicant was performed with the deceased in July, 2019 and after marriage applicant and his family members tortured her for demand of motorcycle and golden chain and on 31.03.2021 they have committed her murder for want of dowry.
sentences._hearing_file: Chhotelal vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023.json

sentences.text:
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and entire allegation of demand of dowry and torture made against him is totally false and baseless and actually deceased committed suicide only due to the reason that some altercation took place Chhotelal vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66743553/
1 between her and her mother-in-law i.e. mother of the applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Chhotelal vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023.json

sentences.text: He further submits that post mortem report of the deceased also suggests that deceased died due to hanging.
sentences._hearing_file: Chhotelal vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023.json

sentences.text: He further submits that applicant is in jail since 03.04.2021 i.e. for more than two years and trial of the case could not be concluded.
sentences._hearing_file: Chhotelal vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023.json

sentences.text: 5. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within two years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances in her matrimonial home and there is also allegation of demand of dowry and applicant failed to provide any plausible explanation with regard to the death of his wife, therefore, he does not deserve bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Chhotelal vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023.json

sentences.text: 6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
sentences._hearing_file: Chhotelal vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023.json

sentences.text: 7. Although, applicant is in jail since 03.04.2021 i.e. for more than two years but he is husband of the deceased and his wife died within two years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances in her matrimonial home and there is also allegation of demand of dowry.
sentences._hearing_file: Chhotelal vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023.json

sentences.text: Further, in the entire bail application, applicant failed to provide any plausible explanation that why his wife committed suicide and applicant in paragraph-15 of the affidavit very casually stated that as some altercation took place between deceased and her mother-in-law, therefore, she committed suicide.
sentences._hearing_file: Chhotelal vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023.json

sentences.text: The defence taken by the applicant appears to be vague and general in nature and merely on such defence entire prosecution story cannot be disbelieved at this stage.
sentences._hearing_file: Chhotelal vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023.json

sentences.text: 8. Further, applicant is facing trial under Section 304B IPC and minimum punishment under Section 304B IPC is seven years, which may be extended up to the life imprisonment and applicant is in jail only for last two years.
sentences._hearing_file: Chhotelal vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023.json

sentences.text:
9. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant, who is husband, is not entitled to be released on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Chhotelal vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023.json

sentences.text: 10. Accordingly, the instant bail application is rejected.
sentences._hearing_file: Chhotelal vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023.json

sentences.text: 11. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Chhotelal vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023.json

sentences.text:
Order Date :- 11.8.2023 AK Pandey  Chhotelal vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66743553/
